title: Lithium
body:
Description

Lithium is an ore that can possibly be found in Smokeslate, Limestone, Chalkyslate and Blueslate.

It has the same square ore shape of Pyrite and Magnetite and has a gray metallic ore color. Its refined and forged state resembles a gray stone.

Trivia

  • Lithium is one of the only ores that do not have a shiny texture when put through a forge.
  • Unlike its real-life counterpart, Lithium does not react with water, rain, or extreme heat (in the Magma Caves), though it is assumed to have already oxidized on the surface.
